headline: The clap test now coaches you mid-slap
lede: Jon's own phone recordings, decoded byte-by-byte, showed exactly why the ±50 ms proof kept missing — silent glass taps and airborne claps. /claptest now names every slap while the take runs: PAIR ✓, NO TOUCH, NO SOUND — teaching the habit on the way to the evidence.

notes.text: LIVE PAIR COACH shipped (PR #2653, #1711 stage): live badge per slap — PAIR ✓ ±ms, OFF (paired but past the line), NO TOUCH, NO SOUND — plus a running matched-pair count. Guidance only: the take bytes, sim and verdict are untouched.

The failure shapes were measured from stored bytes, not guessed: seed144524's clap landed 2.9 s from its tap; seed978353 heard two near-full-scale claps and zero touches. The pair machine reuses the grader's own ±50/±250 ms constants — one law, taught live. recordcheck 240/240 with a hand-mutant killed by name.

S1's last line is unchanged: one take from Jon's phone — volume down, slap the glass 3× ~2 s apart. The page coaches each slap now; the nightly grades it the night it lands (question #2652 files the alternative).
Also: the #2466 habit pill's learned/re-arm honesty got a gate fix, and QA #2654 carries the quiet-machine witness list for the new naming gates.
